title: Fort Dearborn's bird's-eye view now shows on every fort card
items: The 1912 bird's-eye drawing of the first Fort Dearborn opens full size from the Images tab of each blockhouse, range, the magazine, flagstaff and both picket rows in 1812.
It is credited as a later reconstruction, drawn from an 1898 model, not an eyewitness view.
A side-by-side of the 1812 fort against it lists where the two disagree.
